name: MeMento*fragMent
source:
[You] awaken in a pitch-black space, surrounded by mysterious fragments. [You] can't remember who or where you are.

[You] begin collecting the fragments in the hopes they will help you remember...and to find out who the girl reflected within them is.

"MeMento*fragMent" is a visual novel in which [You], the protagonist, recover your memories by viewing memory fragments.

The first contains the past of a girl, traveling alone through a world on the brink of destruction.

Continue watching to learn about her past, your relationship with her, and rediscover your identity.

Don't look away, no matter how tragic the answer may be.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4860030]Steam[/url]]
translation:
【你】在一片漆黑的空间中醒来，四周漂浮着无数神秘的碎片。【你】既想不起自己是谁，也不知道自己身在何处。

【你】开始收集这些碎片，期盼它们能帮自己找回记忆……也想弄清楚映照在碎片之中的那名少女究竟是谁。

《MeMento*fragMent》是一部由身为男主角的【你】通过阅览记忆碎片逐步寻回失落记忆的视觉小说。

第一枚碎片里封存着一名少女的过往——她正独自一人跋涉在濒临毁灭的世界之中。

继续看下去吧，去了解她的过去、你与她之间的羁绊，并重新找回你自己的真实身份。

无论最终揭晓的答案有多么悲惨，都请千万不要移开视线。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4860030]Steam[/url]]
